name: Video Controls
description: Control video speed, repeat a section, and boost tab volume. Audio stays in this browser.

volume-up.description: Amplify this tab and increase gain by one step

volume-down.description: Amplify this tab and decrease gain by one step

reset-controls.description: Reset speed to 1×, gain to 0 dB, and clear the loop

loop-set-a.description: Set A–B repeat start at the current video time

loop-set-b.description: Set A–B repeat end and activate the loop

loop-clear.description: Clear A–B repeat for this tab
